source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: You may Empower this unit for one [Pain token](vsdata:ability/drukhari.power-from-pain) as your [Charge Phase](vsdata:core-rule/charge-phase) begins. While Empowered, it can declare a charge despite having made an [Advance](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move) or [Fall Back](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back) move.
